message: Last weekend, we had a surprise blackout during a storm, and my friend Sarah instantly turned into a ball of panic. While I was digging out my trusty lantern and charging my phone with a power bank, she was frantically searching for candles. I reminded her that we’ve got enough flashlights to light up a small city! It made me realize how important it is to have a few reliable tools ready for these moments. What’s your go-to item for a power outage?
